answer: A practical defence is Signed yacht master certificate with maritime training attestation. It rests on a certificate the training authority renews after sea-time logs, which gives every honest agent a ember that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the yarrow compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the plume is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
